Name: Ahinoam, Wife of David
Summary: Wife of David, the Jezreelitess, and mother of Amnon, born in Hebron.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 3:1: Wife of David, the Jezreelitess, and mother of Amnon, born in Hebron.
LifeLesson: The mention of Ahinoam in 1 Chronicles places this person within the story of God's people under David and his kingdom.
